scripts.check:repo: bun run typecheck && bun run test:eidnara-migration && bun run eidnara:check registry migration/registry.json && for f in migration/waves/*/waivers.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bun run eidnara:check waivers "$f" || exit 1; done && for d in docs/properties/*/; do [ -f "${d%/}/catalog.md" ] || continue; bun run eidnara:property-index "${d%/}" --check && bun run eidnara:check property-catalog "${d%/}/index.json" || exit 1; done && for f in migration/waves/*/property-impact.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bun run eidnara:check property-impact "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in migration/waves/*/architecture-impact.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bun run eidnara:check architecture-impact "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in migration/waves/*/receipt.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bun run eidnara:check receipt "$f" || exit 1; done
